issue.title: Research-swarm lineage derivation still keys on retired __a/__b draft suffixes
issue.description:
`derive_research_swarm_lineage` in `src/sase/artifact_links/derive/_research_lineage.py` hard-codes the research-swarm draft suffixes as `_SWARM_SUFFIXES = ("__a", "__b")`. The `#research_swarm` xprompt in the `sase-research-artifacts` plugin renamed its researcher reports to per-provider suffixes (`<name>__cdx.md`, `__cld.md`, `__grk.md`, `__mus.md`, `__gem.md`) under `<YYYYMM>/<name>/`, so a lead report `<name>/<name>.md` now never emits `derives-from` rows to its drafts: the derivation only looks for `<name>__a.md` / `<name>__b.md` siblings, which current swarms never write. `tests/artifact_links/test_research_lineage.py` still fixtures only `widget__a.md` / `widget__b.md`, so the suite stays green.

The same stale naming appears in `src/sase/sdd/templates/sidecar-research-README.md` ("research-swarm drafts such as `<topic>__a.md`, `<topic>__b.md`").

Suggested direction: derive from any `<stem>__<suffix>.md` sibling in the lead's directory (or from a declared suffix set) rather than a hard-coded pair, and consider how a planned `<stem>__critique.md` companion (an optional `#research_swarm` critique agent) should relate — it is a review of the lead, not a consolidation source, so it should not become a `derives-from` target.

Found while planning the `#research_swarm` critique option; not caused by that work.

task_type_fields.impact: Every current research-swarm lead report is missing its derives-from lineage links to the researcher drafts it consolidated, so artifact-link views cannot trace a consolidated report back to its sources.
task_type_fields.repro: Create <month>/widget/widget.md plus widget__cdx.md and widget__cld.md (the suffixes #research_swarm writes today) and call derive_research_swarm_lineage on research:<month>/widget/widget.md: it returns () instead of two derives-from candidates. The same call with widget__a.md/widget__b.md returns two.

evidence.note: Independent confirmation on master @8a00076f1f during #research_swarm linker-agent research (4 of 5 swarm researchers flagged it too): _SWARM_SUFFIXES is still ("__a", "__b"). New angle: the planned opt-in linker makes the lead write <name>/<name>__final.md and a linker publish <name>/<name>.md, so the fix should treat __final.md as the published report's derives-from source (and drafts as __final's sources), not as a sibling draft. The #research xprompt's registration example label (research:202609/topic__a.md) also still cites __a. See research:202609/research_swarm_linker_agent/research_swarm_linker_agent.md.
